mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id, assembly_type, assembly_order, assembly_config, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_agent_assembly_config WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY assembly_order

SELECT id, agent_id, assembly_type, assembly_order, assembly_config, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_agent_assembly_config WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND assembly_type = #{assemblyType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY assembly_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_assembly_config (agent_id, assembly_type, assembly_order, assembly_config, status) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{assemblyType}, #{assemblyOrder}, #{assemblyConfig}, #{status})
